text:
Tara (billing): Noticed ~128 customers with duplicate NetSuite credit memos from last nightly sync. Stripe shows a single refund id for each.
Noah (eng): do we have any recent infra changes?
deploy-bot: deploy complete: release/2026-07-12-03:05 by @Noah
Noah (eng): we rolled a small change to trim trailing whitespace from some vendor headers at the proxy. Looks like it accidentally trimmed the HMAC header value on a subset of requests.
Sam (ops): if the signature value changed, verifier rejects and our async replay queue reprocesses. Does replay key include the raw signature header value?
Noah (eng): yes — our idempotency hash included the full headers blob. If whitespace is trimmed, replay produces a different key and re-applies the refund.
Tara (billing): logs show pattern: 
```
WARN billing:webhook - signature mismatch for evt_Ab12
INFO billing:replay - enqueued evt_Ab12 attempt=1
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit_memo CM-5017 for refund rf_Ab12
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit_memo CM-5018 for refund rf_Ab12 (replayed)
```
Noah (eng): root cause = proxy trimming HMAC header value + idempotency key built from non-deterministic fields. Fix plan: (1) stop mutating signature header for /webhooks, (2) make signature verification tolerant to extra whitespace, (3) compute idempotency using stable keys (stripe_event_id + refund_id).
Sam (ops): I'll open a high-priority ticket and coordinate rollback of the header-trim rule for webhook routes.
billing-bot: created ticket FIN-9981: "Proxy trimmed HMAC header -> replayed refunds created duplicate NetSuite credit memos" assigned to Noah, priority P1
Tara (billing): remediation: can we auto-void the later credit memo when external_ref matches and amounts match and created within 20 minutes? ~128 customers affected. Need finance approval for automated void + audit notes.
Noah (eng): I can push a hotfix to the proxy now and update the idempotency code. Will add unit tests to ensure header-value variations don't change the idempotency key.
Tara (billing): Approved for auto-void up to 150 accounts pending hotfix confirmation and a dry-run. Please post dry-run output to #finance-updates.
Noah (eng): hotfix deployed at 1765440000, proxy logs show signature preserved. Will run dry-run and then the backfill.
Tara (billing): thanks all — will monitor customer reports and schedule outreach if needed. :thumbsup:
